title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Autumn Sparkle | Waverly Place | Allied Brass | Bathroom Vanity Shelf Organizer | Allied Brass
description:
Running out of room at the sink? This wall-mounted glass shelf creates storage above the vanity while the integrated towel bar keeps a hand towel within reach in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Add a convenient towel holder under the shelf with the integrated towel bar
- Choose enduring hardware made from solid brass
- Coordinate transitional bath accessories with the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and a cohesive look

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Wall mount glass shelf / bathroom vanity shelf with towel bar
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall projection: 5 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available
